statements.t: Management has identified that the determination of ACL and impairment of goodwill are critical estimates that are particularly susceptible to material change within future periods.

We believe that our future liquidity needs will be satisfied through maintaining an adequate level of cash and cash equivalents, by maintaining readily available access to traditional funding sources, and through proceeds received from the investment and loan portfolios.
We believe that our current sources of funds will enable us to meet all cash obligations as they come due.
We seek to maintain a level of capital sufficient to support existing assets and anticipated asset growth, maintain favorable access to capital markets, and preserve high-quality credit ratings.
Due to the ongoing geopolitical tensions and resulting higher energy prices, we expect uncertainty with respect to economic conditions to remain elevated, which may result in future FOMC actions.
Based on our most current evaluation, we believe that the ACL appropriately reflects expected credit losses in the loan portfolio as of September 30, 2026.
